title: Algerian Lentil Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian-inspired stew made with red lentils, jazzed up with aromatic spices and a hint of cheesy goodness.
instructions: Heat the tagine in a large pot over medium heat.
Saute the jazzy and algerian spices for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the cheesy goodness and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
